queries_run: FormFactor FORM analyst consensus vs guidance 2026
FORM FormFactor price target analyst consensus 2026

findings.claim: 2026-07-29 公司將 Q3 2026 guidance 上調：EPS $0.77–$0.95、營收 $260–$280M，高於當時分析師預期 EPS $0.60、營收 $246.2M（guidance 高於共識）。
findings.source: MarketBeat / Northland estimate article via search summary
findings.excerpt: FormFactor raised its Q3 2026 guidance to EPS of $0.77–$0.95 and revenue of $260 million–$280 million, both above analysts' estimates of $0.60 EPS and $246.2 million in revenue.

findings.claim: Northland 於 2026-07-30 前後把 Q3 2026 EPS 預估由 $0.55 上修至 $0.78（高於 guidance 中點），FY2026 EPS $2.70、FY2027 $2.76。
findings.source: MarketBeat: Northland Securities estimates FormFactor Q3 earnings
findings.excerpt: Northland Securities raised FormFactor's Q3 2026 earnings estimate to $0.78 per share from $0.55, above the company's guidance range midpoint. The firm projects $2.70 EPS for fiscal 2026 and $2.76 for fiscal 2027.

findings.claim: Chartmill 顯示 FY2026 EPS 共識最新紀錄 3.12（13 位分析師，2026-10-18）；Q3 預估 EPS 0.88、營收約 275.9M，Q3 財報預定 10/28。
findings.excerpt: Latest recorded estimate: 3.12 USD · Oct 18, 2026 · 13 analysts

findings.claim: Fintel 最新紀錄（2026-10-02）一年期平均目標價 $145.55，區間 64.64–210.00，中位數 160.65；Investing.com 平均 144.67、高 175、低 64。

Seeking Alpha 修正頁：EPS 下修 0 次、營收上修 9 次、下修 0 次（上修趨勢）。
